expected.finding: **[P1]** Field mining can publish credentials as policy keywords. In [revise-improvement-policy.py:317](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:317), keywords are copied from failure excerpts into the public policy and history. Removing excerpts from `mined_from` does not prevent disclosure through those keywords. A synthetic reproduction with five failures containing `passphrase violetorchard` produced an accepted revision containing `violetorchard`. Require a safe vocabulary or explicit review before publishing field-derived words.

**[P1]** The log preview bypasses excerpt suppression. [revise-improvement-policy.yml:115](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/.github/workflows/revise-improvement-policy.yml:115) prints the first 30 stdout lines, but the miner appends full JSON containing commands and excerpts even without `--show-excerpts`. For a short report, those fields reach public workflow logs. A mocked CLI reproduction placed the synthetic passphrase on line 24. Print only the human report before the `---` boundary, or suppress stdout JSON when `--out-json` is supplied.
